behaviour: Add parseEntityPreviousNames(entity: Entity): string[] to parse, normalize, validate, filter, and deduplicate backstage.io/previous-names entries.
rules: 1. Import ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES alongside DEFAULT_NAMESPACE from './constants' and import { KubernetesValidatorFunctions } from '../validation/KubernetesValidatorFunctions'.
2. Read rawAnnotation = entity.metadata?.annotations?.[ANNOTATION_PREVIOUS_NAMES]; if typeof rawAnnotation !== 'string' or !rawAnnotation.trim() or !entity.kind or !entity.metadata?.name, return [].
3. Compute entityNamespace = entity.metadata.namespace || DEFAULT_NAMESPACE and currentRef = stringifyEntityRef({ kind: entity.kind, namespace: entityNamespace, name: entity.metadata.name }).
4. Split rawAnnotation on ',', trim each entry, skip empty strings, and inside a try/catch call parseEntityRef(entry, { defaultKind: entity.kind, defaultNamespace: entityNamespace }).

5. Skip any entry where parseEntityRef throws, where parsed.kind.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US') !== entity.kind.toLocaleLowerCase('en-US'), or where !KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidKind(parsed.kind) || !KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidNamespace(parsed.namespace) || !KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName(parsed.name).
6. Normalize each valid entry with stringifyEntityRef(parsed), skip any entry equal to currentRef, deduplicate while preserving order using a Set<string>, and return Array.from(result).
